title: Chunk
description: An immutable retrieval and citation unit derived from a Document, aligned to the Document's own structure rather than a fixed-size window. Reprocessing a Document produces a fresh Chunking Generation, never overwriting existing Chunks (ADR-0003).

document_id.description: The Document this Chunk was derived from.

chunking_generation_id.description: Which run of the chunking strategy produced this Chunk (ADR-0003, ADR-0004). Multiple generations for the same document_id can coexist; only the Document's active_chunking_generation_id is eligible for retrieval.

locator.description: The structural locator within the source Document (e.g. a section or clause identifier), so a citation can be verified against the original.
